missing_diagrams.diagram_kind: DAG with structural equations and independent noise inputs
missing_diagrams.rationale: The definition is explicitly built on a finite DAG and recursively maps parent variables and noise to each observed variable. One small generic schematic would clarify the parent-to-child direction and the model’s equation at each node. This is a useful optional diagram, not a defect.
missing_diagrams.draw_or_check: For a small DAG such as X_1 → X_2 and X_1 → X_3, depict each edge as parent input to f_j, show an independent N_j entering each node, and label X_j=f_j(X_pa(j))+N_j. Indicate that all graph vertices are observed and avoid suggesting independence of the X_j; independence is assumed only for the noises.
missing_diagrams.status: candidate only; the source is complete and the absence of a diagram is not a defect.
